headlines: SPY indicated about +1.2% in premarket after Election Day; Stocklake pulse: IWM +1.9%, QQQ +0.4%, gold GLD +3.2%
Stocktwits trending premarket: DJT -11.3%, SPCX -6.8%, RIOT +12.3%, NVO +5.4%, AMD flat
Today: ADP jobs 13:15 UTC, ISM services 15:00 UTC (prior 54.9)

rumors.text: Posters say election night went the Democrats' way (a 'blue wave') and that bulls are providing exit liquidity for a fade
rumors.why: If the premarket gap is sold into, the bearish crowd is right; results are unconfirmed by this reader

rumors.text: Posters expect DJT to fall hard on the election outcome (premarket -11%)
rumors.why: Political-sentiment stock trading on the vote; cause of the move not confirmed

rumors.text: Poster says tech is flat while SPY gaps up, and premarket looks misleading
rumors.why: A gap led by small caps rather than tech may be less durable

plays.reason: Extreme fear (19) and bearish crowd (37) lean contrarian, but the gap is already large so edge is thin
plays.catalyst: Election clarity, ISM services at 15:00 UTC

readings.whats_new: SPY gapped up to about 763.2 (+1.2%) premarket from 753.9 yesterday, after the election; the crowd stays bearish (Stocktwits 37, up from 32) and fear and greed is still about 19. Small caps lead (IWM +1.9%), tech is flat, and DJT and SPCX are sharply lower. ADP and ISM services are due today.
